correctness.rationale: The polar radical of q=ax²+by²+cz²+dyz+ezx+fxy is (d,e,f) off its vanishing plane, giving discriminant ad²+be²+cf²+def and partial derivatives d²,e²,f²,ef,df,de. The cubic is geometrically primitive and linear in a,b,c; singular locus support L has codimension 2 in D, so geometric integrality plus S2 and R1 prove normality. In blowup chart d=t,e=tu,f=tv the defining equation pulls back to t²(a+bu²+cv²+tuv); removing t² gives smooth strict transform with a coefficient 1, and analogous charts. Globally this is P_B(K), kernel of surjective O³⊕O(−1)→O(2); rank3, smooth. Ambient blowup of codimension3 center contributes +2E, cubic strict transform 3H−2E, hence K_~D=−3H=π*K_D, crepant. t=0 gives smooth exceptional P_B(K0)→B, while geometric fiber over L is nonreduced double line. The exact sequence 0→K0→K→O(−1)→0 makes U→B a torsor under K0(1). Its extension is image of DEF under H⁰(O(3))→H¹(K0(1)): image of (D²,E²,F²)H⁰(O(1)) is precisely nine of ten cubic monomials; DEF is absent, so class nonzero and no section. Zariski-local torsor triviality gives [U]=L²[P²], and [D]=[U]+[L]; direct independent characteristic-two GF(2) count gives 35 as (2²+2+1)(2²+1), while all-fields and all-q results follow algebraically.

value.rationale: A classical singular discriminant acquires a transparent crepant smooth model whose complementary affine fibration is Zariski locally trivial but provably globally nonsplit. The cohomological DEF obstruction explains a geometric distinction invisible to motivic class and finite-field point counts. That is a structural characteristic-two geometry result with naturally important base and invariant, not only a known point-count computation.

final_claim: For every field k of characteristic two, the universal ternary-conic discriminant D⊂P5 has smooth crepant blowup along its singular plane identified with P_B(K); its open complement over polar B=P² is a genuinely nonsplit K0(1)-torsor with obstruction [DEF] generating H¹, yet D has motivic class (1+L+L²)(1+L²) and corresponding even-q zeta function.
limitations: The universal discriminant equation, normality and exceptional incidence already have prior coverage; novelty limited to claimed resolution/torsor interpretation and obstruction.
